title: tune-nccl-overlap-collectives-kvcache-scheduling-for-tensor-parallel
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: tensor-parallel multi-GPU workloads experienced suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and GPU compute when KV cache promotions and continuous-batching are active. This PR tunes NCCL stream usage, prioritizes collective streams in the runtime scheduler, and adjusts kernel launch ordering to increase overlap and reduce tail latency. Changes are focused on three areas: 1) NCCL communicator and stream management (per-collective streams with configurable priorities), 2) runtime scheduling heuristics to prefer collective streams that unblock kernel-critical paths, and 3) KV cache promotion and continuous-batching adjustments so communication can run concurrently with KV cache reads/writes. Summary of changes: introduced a new runtime config (tp_nccl_streams and tp_nccl_priority_map) with sane defaults for A100/H100; create dedicated NCCL streams for allreduce/allgather/pt2p and attach explicit priorities; update the scheduler to detect pending collectives and temporarily elevate their stream priority while avoiding starvation of compute kernels; add KVCacher cooperative mode so KV cache memory copies are performed on separate streams that can overlap with collectives; tweak continuous-batching logic to submit batched kernels in an order that exposes more collective/compute overlap. Testing and results: unit and integration tests updated; benchmarks on an 8xA100 tensor-parallel setup show ~18% throughput improvement for long-sequence continuous-batching workloads and 12% reduction in p95 generation latency for mixed sequence lengths. Allreduce latency reduced ~22% in microbenchmarks. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime config, staged rollout to Dedicated clusters first, monitor tp_collective_latency and tp_kvcache_miss_rate dashboards. Notes: there are no API surface changes for external SDKs; config defaults keep previous behavior unless enabled. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration tests added, [x] perf tests added, [x] docs updated (runtime/config), [x] staged rollout plan in linear. Related: ENG-2019 (tensor-parallel perf investigation), ENG-2102 (kv-cache continuous batching followup).
commits: Initial NCCL stream and priority map implementation
Scheduler: add collective priority window and starvation avoidance
KV cache: introduce cooperative copy streams and unit tests
Continuous batching: reorder submit sequence to increase overlap
Perf: add microbench harness for tp collectives and compare baseline
review_comments: Diego Morales: Could we make the per-collective stream count configurable per-device? Some older GPUs need fewer streams to avoid scheduling pressure. Response: Yes — added tp_nccl_streams config that accepts per-device overrides and a fallback to the sensible default.

Priya Kapoor: On H100 we see a slight increase in p50 for short sequences after enabling this. Is there a way to keep short-sequence latency stable? Response: Added a heuristic that disables aggressive stream priority windows when average sequence length < 64; this preserves short-seq p50 while keeping long-seq gains.

Liam O'Connor: Please add a test that verifies no deadlock when KVCacher cooperative mode is enabled and collectives are active. Response: Added integration test tp_collectives_test.py that simulates kvcache hits/misses and parallel collectives; CI exercised this in integration jobs.
Diego Morales (final): Looks good after requested changes; approving.
release_notes: Runtime: improved NCCL stream scheduling and priorities for tensor-parallel collectives to increase comm/compute overlap
Runtime: KV cache cooperative copy streams to overlap memory copies with collectives
Performance: up to 18% throughput increase for long-sequence continuous-batching on 8xA100; ~22% allreduce latency improvement in microbenchmarks
